dmNotes: The shadowy figure is secretly the courier Bob. Do not reveal his dead-drop allegiance.

approvedPublic.name: shadowy figure
approvedPublic.summary: A figure waits beside the platform clock.

records.name: Bob
records.body: Existing fragment: the courier Bob likes black tea.
